text:
alice: Quick flag — noticed a lot of surface inconsistency: Console labels a setting 'routing lane', the Quickstart panel calls it 'traffic lane', and our SDK docs use 'route band'. New hires hit this during the tutorial. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.example/term-gap-3.png tom: Yikes. Sounds like copy drift. Is the behavior different or just the names? alice: Behavior is the same. It's purely naming across Console UI, quickstart panel, and SDK samples. maria: Suggest we pick one canonical user-facing term and add a short parenthetical mapping wherever the old terms appear. My vote: 'routing lane' — it reads well in UI and maps to routing. kai: Engineering note: our telemetry events use routing_lane.* already, so picking 'routing lane' avoids backend churn. That said, docs still say 'route band' in examples. We should alias search/docs redirects for 60 days. alice: Proposed microcopy for the Quickstart panel: ```html

Routing lane (aka traffic lane / route band)

Routing lanes determine how requests are split across deployments. Learn more: Routing lanes.

``` Keep the mapping visible (no hover-only). maria: UX: add a small info button with aria-describedby pointing to the parenthetical text. Tooltip fine as enhancement but not the only accessible source. kai: I'll add a compatibility alias layer in docs search and create redirects from /docs/route-band and /docs/traffic-lane to /docs/routing-lanes. Telemetry is fine. tom: QA to add: visual regression for narrow widths to ensure the parenthetical doesn't overflow the card, and an a11y check that screen reader reads the full header. qa-bot can run the a11y check in CI. qa-bot: Filed QA-7291 (visual + a11y tests) and will add a Jest snapshot for the quickstart component. docs-bot: Created DOCS-6132 (glossary + redirects) and UX-4210 (console microcopy). @maria assigned for copy review. alice: Rollout plan: patch quickstart panel copy + docs page next week behind FF, Console change behind gradual flag, redirects live day one. We'll keep old doc slugs live for 60 days. maria: I'll post the final microcopy in UX-4210 and include accessible examples and the info-button markup. kai: I'll open the docs-redirect PR and include a short migration note on the docs landing: "Routing lanes formerly surfaced as 'traffic lane' and 'route band'." alice: Thanks — sounds good. Closing after UX-4210 merges. :thumbsup:
